trigger.interpretation: Exact fairness minimization selected low-compression moves and fit exposed development means without beating Classical transfer or cost.

rule: Among every eligible pair with strict exact development-objective descent, maximize exact realized training compression. Break ties by lower post-merge objective, then lexicographically larger pair. If none exists, maximize exact realized training compression with the same secondary ties.
mathematical_role: Lexicographic constrained optimization: training compression is optimized subject to strict fairness descent, avoiding a tuned scalar tradeoff weight.

arms.eff_minmax: Maximum of the two domain-level two-language Ginis.
arms.eff_pooled: Gini after summing domain token totals; matched aggregation control.
arms.exact_train: Always maximize exact realized training compression; matched train-gain control.

held_constant: all-eligible-pair search, exact nonoverlap gains, one process and one thread
primary_prediction: eff_minmax will reduce mean book total cost relative to full_minmax while retaining lower mean book Gini than full_pooled.
falsifiers: Mean book total cost is not lower than full_minmax.
Mean book Gini is not lower than full_pooled.
Any predicted selected-pair train or development gain disagrees with the realized replacement or independent final tokenizer totals.
secondary_comparisons: Classical BPE remains the strong simple baseline.
exact_train quantifies the cost and fairness effect of the fairness constraint under matched gain accounting.
All ten Books works and both TICO files are exposed development diagnostics, not confirmation.

resource_plan.pilot: 100 merges on eff_minmax before full runs

decision.if_supported: Retain as an efficiency-aware candidate, then require truly unexposed source/author-level confirmation and third-language extension.
decision.if_fairness_or_cost_fails: Keep the negative result and analyze whether per-step lexicographic descent, aggregate Gini, or exposed-domain overfit is the limiting mechanism.
